account_move.aliases.add.description.defaultMessage: A handle such as @name@example.com, or the address of the account. You can have up to {max} aliases.
account_move.aliases.add.description.description: Help text of the field for the account to add as an alias. {max} is the most aliases a user can have.

account_move.aliases.add.field.description: Label of the field for the account to add as an alias.

account_move.aliases.add.required.defaultMessage: Enter a handle or an address.
account_move.aliases.add.required.description: Error of the alias field when it is empty.

account_move.aliases.add.title.description: Heading of the section with the form that adds an alias.

account_move.aliases.add_failed.defaultMessage: The alias could not be added: {reason}
account_move.aliases.add_failed.description: Error next to the form that adds an alias. {reason} is the server's explanation.

account_move.aliases.added.description: Status message after an alias is added. {name} is the alias's handle or address.

account_move.aliases.description.defaultMessage: An alias names an account you are moving from. Add it here before that account moves its followers to you. An alias alone changes nothing.
account_move.aliases.description.description: Explains what an alias is, below the heading of the aliases page.

account_move.aliases.empty.description: Text of the list of aliases when the user has none.

account_move.aliases.item.since.description: Under an alias: when the user added it. {date} is a date in the user's locale and time zone.

account_move.aliases.limit.defaultMessage: You have {max} aliases, the most there can be. Remove one to add another.
account_move.aliases.limit.description: Replaces the form that adds an alias when the user has the most aliases. {max} is that number.

account_move.aliases.list.title.description: Heading of the section that lists the user's aliases.

account_move.aliases.move_link.defaultMessage: Move your account to another account
account_move.aliases.move_link.description: Link from the aliases page to the page that moves the account.

account_move.aliases.remove_failed.defaultMessage: The alias could not be removed: {reason}
account_move.aliases.remove_failed.description: Error under the list of aliases when removing one failed. {reason} is the server's explanation.

account_move.aliases.remove_of.description: Accessible name of the button that removes an alias. {name} is the alias's handle or address.

account_move.aliases.removed.description: Status message after an alias is removed. {name} is the alias's handle or address.

account_move.aliases.title.description: Heading and menu entry of the settings page of the account's aliases.

account_move.cancel.close.description: Button in the dialog that closes it without cancelling the move.

account_move.cancel.confirm.description: Button in the dialog that cancels the move.

account_move.cancel.description.defaultMessage: This account can post and follow again, and other servers are told. Followers who already moved stay with {handle}. You cannot move again for 30 days after the move.
account_move.cancel.description.description: Description of the dialog that cancels the move. {handle} is the new account's handle.

account_move.cancel.done.description: Status message after the move was cancelled.

account_move.cancel.failed.defaultMessage: The move could not be cancelled: {reason}
account_move.cancel.failed.description: Error in the dialog that cancels the move. {reason} is the server's explanation.

account_move.cancel.open.description: Button that opens the dialog that cancels the move of the account.

account_move.cancel.title.description: Title of the dialog that asks the user to confirm cancelling the move.

account_move.closure.move.description: Link in the notice of the server's closure to the page that moves the account.

account_move.move.confirm.cancel.description: Button in the dialog that closes it without moving the account.

account_move.move.confirm.description.defaultMessage: Enter your password to confirm. Your followers follow {handle}, and this account says that it moved. You cannot move again for 30 days.
account_move.move.confirm.description.description: Description of the dialog that moves the account. {handle} is the new account's handle.

account_move.move.confirm.description_pa.defaultMessage: Your browser asks for one of your passkeys to confirm. Your followers follow {handle}, and this account says that it moved. You cannot move again for 30 days.
account_move.move.confirm.description_pa.description: Description of the dialog that moves the account of a user who has no password. {handle} is the new account's handle.

account_move.move.confirm.export.defaultMessage: Export your follows, blocks, mutes, and bookmarks as CSV files
account_move.move.confirm.export.description: Link in the dialog that moves the account to the page that exports the user's lists as CSV files, to import them into the new account.

account_move.move.confirm.moves.description: Heading in the dialog that moves the account, above what moves to the new account.

account_move.move.confirm.moves.follower.description: Item in the dialog that moves the account: the followers move to the new account.

account_move.move.confirm.stays.description: Heading in the dialog that moves the account, above what stays with this account.

account_move.move.confirm.stays.items.defaultMessage: Your posts, the accounts you follow, your blocks, mutes, and bookmarks
account_move.move.confirm.stays.items.description: Item in the dialog that moves the account: what does not move to the new account.

account_move.move.confirm.submit.description: Button in the dialog that moves the account.

account_move.move.confirm.title.description: Title of the dialog that asks the user to confirm moving the account. {handle} is the new account's handle.

account_move.move.description.defaultMessage: Move this account to another account, on this server or on another. Your followers follow the new account, and this account says that it moved.
account_move.move.description.description: Explains what moving the account does, below the heading of the move page.

account_move.move.done.description: Status message after the account moved. {handle} is the new account's handle.

account_move.move.failed.defaultMessage: The account could not be moved: {reason}
account_move.move.failed.description: Error in the dialog that moves the account when it failed. {reason} is the server's explanation.

account_move.move.form.title.description: Heading of the section with the form that names the account to move to.

account_move.move.lookup_failed.defaultMessage: That account could not be found: {reason}
account_move.move.lookup_failed.description: Error next to the form that names the account to move to. {reason} is the server's explanation.

account_move.move.password.field.description: Label of the password field in the dialog that moves the account.

account_move.move.password.required.description: Error of the password field in the dialog that moves the account.

account_move.move.prerequisite.defaultMessage: First, add this account as an alias of the new account, in that account's settings. This account's address is {url}.
account_move.move.prerequisite.description: Tells the user to set this account as an alias of the new account before moving. {url} is this account's address.

account_move.move.target.description.defaultMessage: A handle such as @name@example.com, or the address of the account.
account_move.move.target.description.description: Help text of the field for the account to move to.

account_move.move.target.field.description: Label of the field for the account to move to.

account_move.move.target.required.defaultMessage: Enter a handle or an address.
account_move.move.target.required.description: Error of the field for the account to move to when it is empty.

account_move.move.target.submit.description: Button that looks up the account to move to and opens the confirmation.

account_move.move.title.description: Heading and menu entry of the settings page that moves the account to another account.

account_move.move.wrong_password.description: Error in the dialog that moves the account when the password is wrong.

account_move.moved.description.defaultMessage: This account moved to {handle}. Its followers follow the new account. You can still sign in, read, export your data, and delete the account, but you cannot post, boost, react, follow, or vote.
account_move.moved.description.description: Explains the state of an account that has moved. {handle} is the new account's handle.

account_move.moved.target.description: Link from the move page to the new account's profile. {handle} is the new account's handle.

account_move.moved.title.description: Heading of the section of the move page for an account that has moved.

account_move.profile.manage.description: Link on the profile of the user's own moved account to the page that shows and cancels the move.

account_move.profile.moved.description: Note on the profile of an account that moved. {name} is its name; {target} is a link to the new account, with its handle.

account_move.profile.moved_self.description: Note on the profile of the signed-in user's own account after it moved. {target} is a link to the new account, with its handle.
